verdict.rationale: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at app.puzzle.io/rest/v0/openapi.yaml that downloads without authentication and feeds its ReadMe API reference. The probe 404s were against help.puzzle.io paths, so they do not contradict the app-domain spec. Missing for 10: discoverability (the spec URL is not linked from any docs page and the ReadMe download button is admin-gated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document (info title "Puzzle Api", server https://app.puzzle.io/rest/v0) on its app domain
